policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O / GPT-6.1 Sol in Patch the Planet: critical PHP flaws
items.summary: O says GPT-5.6 Sol helped uncover critical PHP vulnerabilities affecting a large share of websites, as part of its Patch the Planet initiative.

items.headline: V / W-7 launched to test cancer drug crystallization in microgravity
items.summary: V reports W-7 launched Oct 20, sending a PROTAC cancer medicine experiment to test whether microgravity can improve solubility via different crystal forms.

items.headline: O / SoftBank completes $10B third tranche follow-on
items.summary: SoftBank reports executing the third and final $10.0B tranche of its follow-on investment in O, bringing cumulative investment to $64.6B and ~13% ownership.
